m00.name: The Fool
m00.image: A young traveler steps toward a cliff edge, a bundle tied to the staff and a white rose in the free hand; a white dog leaps at the heels.
m00.up: A fresh start with a light heart; stepping out before the plan is finished.
m00.down: Recklessness, or the opposite: fear of the first step.
m00.love: A new beginning, or a bond with no clear commitment.
m00.work: A new risk on a road that is not marked yet.

m01.name: The Magician
m01.image: A man at a table, one hand raised to the sky and the other pointing down; wand, cup, sword and coin before him, infinity sign overhead.
m01.up: You already hold every tool; what is left is putting them to work.
m01.down: Talent left idle, or manipulation and sleight of hand.
m01.love: A strong pull; the first move is yours.
m01.work: Skill and opportunity are both here right now.

m02.name: The High Priestess
m02.image: A woman seated between a black pillar and a white one, a veil behind her, a crescent moon at her foot and a scroll in her lap.
m02.up: Something is still hidden; the answer comes from inside, not outside.
m02.down: Brushing off your own instinct, or a secret that surfaces.
m02.love: Feelings left unsaid, a relationship kept quiet.
m02.work: Information nobody has handed you yet.

m03.name: The Empress
m03.image: A woman reclining on cushions in a field of ripe wheat, a crown of twelve stars, a shield with the sign of Venus beside her.
m03.up: Abundance and fertility; something is genuinely growing.
m03.down: Neglecting yourself, or care that smothers.
m03.work: A project starting to bear fruit.

m04.name: The Emperor
m04.image: An imposing man on a stone throne with ram heads at its corners, a scepter in his hand and dry mountains behind him.
m04.up: Structure and authority; here control comes through order.
m04.down: Stubbornness at the wrong moment, or power misused.
m04.love: A relationship with rules, or a man who takes charge.

m05.name: The Hierophant
m05.image: A priest on a temple throne in a three-tiered crown, two followers kneeling at his feet and two crossed keys on the floor.
m05.up: Tradition and settled rules; guidance from someone with more road behind them.
m05.down: Breaking with custom, or clinging to a rule with nothing left in it.
m05.work: A traditional institution, time to study.

m06.name: The Lovers
m06.image: A naked man and woman under a large angel; a tree in flames behind him, the tree with the serpent behind her.
m06.up: A deep bond, or a choice about values that only you can make.
m06.down: A mismatch, or a choice made out of fear.
m06.love: Real closeness, or a fork in the heart.
m06.work: Partnership, a choice between two roads.

m07.name: The Chariot
m07.image: A warrior stands in a chariot pulled by two sphinxes, one black and one white; a canopy of stars above him.
m07.up: Victory by willpower; hold the reins and you get there.
m07.down: Losing control, or moving with no direction.
m07.love: The relationship moves ahead, but it takes effort.

m08.name: Strength
m08.image: A calm woman closes the jaws of a big lion with both hands; the infinity sign floats over her head.
m08.up: Soft strength; this one is tamed by patience, not by force.
m08.down: Doubting yourself, or anger with no brake on it.
m08.love: Patient kindness is what holds the bond together.
m08.work: Quiet persistence is what pays off.

m09.name: The Hermit
m09.image: An old man alone on a summit, a lantern holding a six-pointed star in one hand and a staff in the other.
m09.up: Stepping back to understand; the answer shows up in the quiet.
m09.down: Too much isolation, or running from solitude you need.
m09.love: Distance, or a bond that needs quiet.

m10.name: Wheel of Fortune
m10.image: A great wheel covered in symbols hangs in the sky; a snake, a jackal and a sphinx ride it, four winged creatures in the corners.
m10.up: Luck turns; something shifts without your hand on it.
m10.down: Stuck circling the same loop, delay.
m10.love: A turning point in the relationship.
m10.work: An opening that arrives from outside.

m11.name: Justice
m11.image: A woman enthroned between two pillars, scales in her left hand and a raised double-edged sword in her right.
m11.up: You reap what you planted; the decision will be fair.
m11.down: Injustice, or dodging your own share of it.
m11.love: The balance in the pair, or the lack of it, is plain to see.

m12.name: The Hanged Man
m12.image: A man hangs upside down by one foot from a T-shaped living tree, hands behind his back, a halo around his head; his face is calm.
m12.up: A forced pause; change your angle and the road opens.
m12.down: Stubbornly pushing on, or a sacrifice that buys nothing.

m13.name: Death
m13.image: An armored skeleton on a white horse under a black banner with a white rose; a king lies fallen, the sun rises between two towers.
m13.up: A chapter closes for good; that is what makes room for the next one.
m13.down: Holding on to something that is already over.
m13.love: The end of a relationship, or a deep change in it.

m14.name: Temperance
m14.image: An angel pours water from one cup into another, one foot in the water and one on land; behind, a path toward the sun.
m14.up: Moderation and the right mix; this one is going to take time.
m14.down: Overdoing it, impatience, things out of tune.
m14.love: A bond that settles into place slowly.

m15.name: The Devil
m15.image: A half-goat, half-human figure with bat wings on a pedestal; below, a chained man and woman whose chains hang loose.
m15.up: Dependence, and a cage that stays shut because you hold it shut.
m15.down: The chain breaks, the dependence becomes visible.
m15.love: Strong attraction, but not a healthy one.
m15.work: A suffocating contract, money that traps.

m16.name: The Tower
m16.image: A tower on a cliff top: lightning knocks the crown off it and everything burns; two people fall from the windows.
m16.up: Something with a weak foundation comes down all at once.
m16.down: Postponing a collapse that is coming anyway.
m16.love: A sudden break, or a truth that comes out.

m17.name: The Star
m17.image: A woman kneels at a pool, one foot in the water, emptying two jugs onto the land and into the pool; a large star above her.
m17.up: Hope and healing after a blow; the road is lit again.
m17.down: Discouragement, or no faith in what is coming.
m17.love: Healing, and hope that comes back.
m17.work: Inspiration, a path that has cleared.

m18.name: The Moon
m18.image: A path winds away between two towers; a dog and a wolf howl, a crayfish crawls from the water, the moon hangs over it all.
m18.up: Fog and illusion; things are not what they look like.
m18.down: The fog lifts and the truth gets clear.
m18.love: Doubt, things held back, a fear with no name.
m18.work: Half the information, someone playing dirty.

m19.name: The Sun
m19.image: A child on a white horse holds up a red banner; four tall sunflowers rise behind a brick wall, a huge sun fills the sky.
m19.up: Clarity and success out in the open; the best card in the deck.
m19.down: Joy postponed, optimism with nothing under it.

m20.name: Judgement
m20.image: An angel sounds a trumpet and people rise from open coffins with their arms lifted.
m20.up: A call you cannot wave off; the account with the past gets settled.
m20.down: Not hearing the call, staying stuck in regret.
m20.love: Forgiveness, or someone from the past coming back.
m20.work: A big decision, a new calling.

m21.name: The World
m21.image: A woman dances inside a wreath of leaves, a baton in each hand; four creatures sit in the corners of the card.
m21.up: A cycle completed; you reached what you set out for.
m21.down: Something left half done and never closed.

w01.name: Ace of Wands
w01.image: A hand comes out of a cloud offering a wand with fresh leaves sprouting; a castle sits on the hills in the distance.
w01.up: The spark of a new start; the energy is there, you just pick it up.
w01.down: A spark that went out, or a start pushed back.
w01.love: A start full of heat, fresh attraction.
w01.work: A new idea, an offer of work.

w02.name: Two of Wands
w02.image: A man on a castle wall holds a globe and looks at the horizon; one wand is in his hand, the other fixed to the wall.
w02.up: The plan is ready and your feet have not moved; time to decide.
w02.down: Fear of leaving the comfortable spot, a plan that stays on paper.
w02.love: A decision about where the relationship goes.

w03.name: Three of Wands
w03.image: A man seen from behind stands on high ground watching ships at sea; three wands are planted beside him, one in his hand.
w03.up: What you planted is already on its way; the horizon has opened.
w03.down: The result runs late, or your view is too short.
w03.love: Waiting on good news from the other person.

w04.name: Four of Wands
w04.image: An arch of flowers between four standing wands; two people hold bouquets up, a castle behind them.
w04.up: Celebration and relief; a stage closed well.
w04.down: The celebration is postponed, no peace at home.
w04.love: Engagement, a wedding, a shared home.
w04.work: A position made solid, a team that fits.

w05.name: Five of Wands
w05.image: Five young men raise their wands and clash them in the air, each pulling his own way; it does not look serious.
w05.up: Friction and rivalry; nobody has won yet.
w05.down: The squabble ends, or you dodge an argument you needed.
w05.love: Arguing and digging your heels in.
w05.work: Competition at work, a team out of step.

w06.name: Six of Wands
w06.image: A rider in a laurel wreath on a white horse with people walking alongside; his wand carries a wreath too.
w06.up: Victory in plain sight; your work gets recognized.
w06.down: A win with no applause, or pride too early.
w06.love: Your place in the relationship is acknowledged.

w07.name: Seven of Wands
w07.image: A man on high ground holds off six wands coming at him from below, with a single wand in his hands.
w07.up: You will have to hold your ground; the position is defensible.
w07.down: Worn out from defending, or giving in under pressure.
w07.love: Defending the relationship from people who interfere.
w07.work: Holding your spot against a rival.

w08.name: Eight of Wands
w08.image: Eight wands fly through the air in parallel, angled down toward the ground; the sky is clear.
w08.up: Everything is moving fast; news or an event is close.
w08.down: Slowness and delay, or hurry for no reason.
w08.love: A sudden message or move from the other person.

w09.name: Nine of Wands
w09.image: A wounded man with a bandaged forehead leans on his wand and keeps watch; eight wands stand in a row behind him.
w09.up: You are tired but close to the line; one last push is left.
w09.down: Quitting right before the end, or suspicion with no cause.
w09.love: Caution left from an old wound.
w09.work: Holding firm in the last stage.

w10.name: Ten of Wands
w10.image: A man carries all ten wands at once and walks bent over toward a house far off.
w10.up: You took on more weight than you can carry; you arrive, but heavy.
w10.down: Putting the load down, or handing the task to someone else.
w10.love: The whole weight of the relationship on one person.

w11.name: Page of Wands
w11.image: A youth in colorful clothes studies his sprouting wand; behind him, a desert with pyramids.
w11.up: News or a fresh idea; the curiosity is raw but alive.
w11.love: A new attraction with no experience behind it.
w11.work: An internship, word about a job.

w12.name: Knight of Wands
w12.image: A rider in yellow armor on a rearing horse; a red plume juts out of his helmet.
w12.up: Hot, hurried movement; someone who comes in all at once.
w12.down: Rushing without thinking, or falling behind the action.
w12.love: A passionate lover, but not a steady one.
w12.work: A move, a project running at high speed.

w13.name: Queen of Wands
w13.image: A woman on a stone throne, a sunflower in one hand and a wand in the other; a black cat sits at her feet.
w13.up: Warm confidence; a woman who is magnetic and firm at once.
w13.down: Jealousy or instability, confidence on shaky ground.
w13.love: A warm, self-assured woman in the story.

w14.name: King of Wands
w14.image: A man on a throne marked with lion and salamander signs, a long wand in his hand and his gaze turned to one side.
w14.up: Leadership and a big vision; someone who opens the road.
w14.down: Domineering, or promises with nothing behind them.
w14.love: An ambitious man, the one who leads.
